label: Dual Blades
note: MH3U endgame Dual Blades stack Sharpness +1, Razor Sharp, Element Atk Up (1.2x), and Attack Up (L) or Challenger +2. Hallowed Jhen/Yamato Prime provides S+1/Razor/AuL, Helios Z with the X waist is the common early-G base, and Abyssal Lagi is a similar S+1/Razor/AuL option. Elemental DBs match the monster's Fire/Water/Thunder/Ice/Dragon weakness; Slime is a status-like element, so Element Atk Up and Status Atk do not boost it (Bombardier does), and paralysis is mainly multiplayer utility. The model captures S+1, AuL (+20 true raw), and the 1.2x Element Atk Up; Razor Sharp, Honed Blade as a combined skill, Stamina/Mega Dash Juice, Focus, Evasion/Earplugs, Awaken, Bombardier, Challenger +2, and specific Element/Status Atk are not modeled.
